$comment: The healthcare credentialing pack's declaration. This is NOT a JSON Schema: buildExtractionSchema() in harness/core-tools/src/domain/documents/schema.ts expands the target record kind's fields into the inlined JSON Schema sent to the model as response_format. A manifest is used because structured-output support across model vendors is unreliable with $ref and $defs, and because restricted fields must be dropped from the model-facing schema while staying part of the record.

records.label: Provider
records.missingNameError: extraction found no provider name; pass provider_id to attach this document to a known provider

fields.name: first_name
fields.description: The provider's legal given name, as printed on the document.

fields.name: middle_name
fields.description: Middle name or initial, if printed.

fields.name: suffix
fields.description: Generational or degree suffix printed after the name, such as MD, DO or Jr.

fields.name: npi
fields.description: Ten-digit National Provider Identifier. Digits only, no spaces.

fields.name: date_of_birth
fields.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD form.

fields.name: practice_name
fields.description: Name of the practice, group or employer.

fields.name: practice_address
fields.description: Street address of the practice, on one line.

fields.name: malpractice_carrier
fields.description: Name of the malpractice insurance carrier.

fields.name: malpractice_coverage
fields.description: Per-occurrence and aggregate coverage as printed, e.g. $1,000,000 / $3,000,000.

fields.name: ssn
fields.description: Social Security Number. Never requested from a model; filled from the redaction pass.

fields.name: ein
fields.description: Employer Identification Number. Never requested from a model; filled from the redaction pass.

fields.name: dea_number
fields.description: DEA registration number. Never requested from a model; filled from the redaction pass.

$comment_credential_numbers: What is and is not kept from the model. SSN, EIN and DEA numbers are found by the regex pass in harness/core-tools/src/shared/redaction/ and replaced with placeholders BEFORE the document text is put in a prompt, so those three never reach a model. Licence, registration and policy numbers are NOT redacted: redacting every nine-digit string would blank the fields this pipeline exists to read, so they stay in the document text the model sees. They are simply never asked for as fields and never extracted, which is why numberRestricted below is reserved and currently read by nothing: no code path fills an attachment number from a document, so attachments.number_encrypted is always null from extraction. A number stored through providers_upsert by some other caller is still encrypted and masked on the way out.

extraction.role: You read credentialing documents for a medical practice and return structured data.

targets.instruction: Extract the provider details this document evidences.
targets.attachment_instruction:
Also list every credential the document evidences (state licence, DEA registration,
malpractice policy, board certification) with its issuer, state and dates.
Do not report any registration, policy or licence NUMBER: this pipeline does not extract them.
targets.attachment_schema_description: Credentials this document evidences. The registration, licence or policy number is deliberately NOT part of this schema and is not extracted at all: report only the kind, issuer, state and dates.

attachment_descriptions.kind: Which kind of credential this is.
attachment_descriptions.confidence: How sure you are that this credential is present in the document, from 0 to 1.
attachment_descriptions.source_page: The 1-based page this credential was read from.
attachment_descriptions.state: Two-letter US state code, or an empty string when the credential is not state-issued.
attachment_descriptions.issuer: The issuing board, agency or carrier as printed.
attachment_descriptions.issued_at: The issue date in YYYY-MM-DD form, or an empty string when absent.
attachment_descriptions.expires_at: The expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD form, or an empty string when absent.
